How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
A Great Budget-Friendly Alternative to Mom’s Favorite Everyday Tees
I ordered these for my mom because she wears Target’s basic V-neck tees almost every day. She spends a lot of time caring for her grandkids, so her shirts inevitably end up with stains or spills. I wanted to find a more affordable option that she could easily replace when needed. These have been a great alternative. The sizing was very comparable to her Target tees, and when I stacked them side by side, they were nearly identical in size. The fabric is soft, the fit is flattering without being too tight, and they’re comfortable enough for everyday wear. The multipack makes them an excellent value, especially if you go through basic T-shirts often. If you’re looking for simple, comfortable everyday tees at a budget-friendly price, these are definitely worth considering.

    Soft, flattering, and not see-through
    Reviewed in the United States on August 4, 2026

    I absolutely love these shirts! I bought them for a trip because I wanted a few simple, solid colored basics and they did not disappoint.

    The material is soft, comfortable, and lightweight without feeling too thin. They wash really well and haven't shrunk at all. I also love the neckline, it's very flattering and makes the shirts look a little more polished than a basic tee.

    One thing I was most impressed with was the white shirt. I usually avoid wearing white because they're often too see through, but that wasn't the case with these. With a nude bra, I didn't have any issues with transparency which was a huge plus for me.

    These shirts are flattering on their own and also work great for layering under jackets or cardigans. Overall, they're excellent quality for the price and I'll definitely be buying more colors!

    Nicely made t-shirts, but WAY TOO LONG
    Reviewed in the United States on August 18, 2026
    Number of Items: 2Color: Dark Chustnut Brown/NavySize: X-Large

    Odd fit to these t-shirts. They are very narrow, but also very long. Based on reviews, I ordered a size up because I don't want my t-shirts skin tight. Even a size up, the shirt is very form-fitting. And it is so long that it actually covers my entire butt. If you like really long t-shirts, then this one is definitely for you. The fabric is high quality and pretty thick compared to many t-shirts and it is very stretchy. However, it does not stretch out with wearing or washing. It maintains its shape very well.
